parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the instance. You can view the ID of the instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.****

>*   If the instance has an ID, you must specify the **IotInstanceId** parameter. If you do not specify this parameter, the call fails.
>*   If the instance does not have an **ID** or the **Overview** page is not displayed, you do not need to specify this parameter.

For more information, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description: The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device belongs.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot get-device-shadow --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --product-key a1T27vz0000 --device-name device1 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot GetDeviceShadow --region cn-hangzhou --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --ProductKey a1T27vz0000 --DeviceName device1
